rules: A passing deterministic test proves its stated implementation boundary, not all business semantics in the scenario.
Guidance text/snapshot and development-only oracle tests are not Agent behavior evidence.
Synthetic SDK dispatch/read-back is not Salesforce persistence or publication.
Manual real Adapter hooks and explicit helper-output injection are not a real WeCom entry or a complete native hook-to-model chain.
All real WeCom/native-voice scenarios remain NOT_TESTED; no successful real Salesforce CREATE, UPDATE or attachment publication exists in this task.

First 36-run fixture defects and d57 candidate unsupported-source failure remain preserved. Latest 1.13.2 candidate is 18/18 in the fixed-old-Provider synthetic-SDK guidance comparison; this is not production reliability or real Salesforce/WeCom acceptance.

tests.DE2: mutation observer receives the exact submitted fields and Salesforce result record ID
tests.DE3: transport and unstructured SDK exceptions produce unknown outcomes without automatic retry
tests.DE4: CREATE dispatches all 131072 text characters independently of the smaller Context draft bound

tests.DC1: multiple roots correlate child Lookups by explicit references despite different phase ordering
tests.DC2: child partial failure preserves root success and reports incomplete intent without rollback
tests.DC3: after a partial child batch only the failed item qualifies for re-preparation

tests.DB1: per-item Record Type payload, exact submitted fields and request USER isolation

tests.UP2: unknown attempts block replay across uploader instances and retain their fact after byte cleanup
tests.UP3: two concurrent calls issue at most one ContentVersion POST for one ref
tests.UP4: cancellation after claim but before POST releases only that unsent claim
tests.UP5: a POST response body that breaks mid-stream is unknown, retained and never replayed
tests.UP6: facade timeout preserves prior success, names the in-flight unknown and never dispatches the remaining file

tests.UP9: the attachment Tool is enabled only through its own inventory and its own policy
tests.UP10: a staged file whose bytes changed after staging is refused rather than published
tests.UP11: a reference may not be replayed once it has been consumed, and expires on its own clock

tests.MY2: attachment recovery is explicit, expiry-bounded, and never revives legacy/local FAILED rows
tests.MY3: attachment cleanup includes failed and unknown bytes while preserving outcome facts and live claims
tests.MY4: 017 preserves existing staged, consumed and failed rows without making historical failures retryable

M4.notProven: Universal fact coverage, production reliability, candidate backend retryable propagation, automatic Adapter chain, real Salesforce or WeCom
